name: Trooper armor
notes: Origin at the neck base, face +Z, wearer's left +X. Parts helmet, chest, back, shoulderL, shoulderR, gauntletL, gauntletR (pivots at neck base, sternum, between shoulder blades, shoulder joints, elbows; forearm along -Y) plus blaster at the right grip (-0.215, -0.58, 0.05), barrel along +Z. Joints visor, scuff 0...1 drive followers visorGlint and scuffMarks (option switch at 0.05); blaster and recoil are empty drivers for the lens.
parts: rounded dome helmet with broad black teardrop lenses, glint strip, cheek plates, ear discs and slotted mouth vent
layered pectoral and abdomen plates over a black undersuit with utility belt
bell pauldrons with rim and lames
blast rifle with receiver, optic, barrel and status lamp
style: Glossy white molded plate armour over a black undersuit, black lenses, original shapes only.
summary: Glossy white trooper armor kit: dome helmet with black lenses, layered plates over a black undersuit, bell pauldrons, vambraces and a blast rifle, with lens glint and scorch marks.
